title: Visual review verdicts (version 1.0.0)
description: The owner's verdict per diagram element, kept in .discovery/visual-review/<ID>/review.json of the run's repo root (VR-04). One line per (diagram, element): a new verdict on the same element replaces the old line. A line whose anchor.graph_hash differs from the hash of the diagram file as it is now is outdated (made on an older graph) and is not counted as checked; a line whose element is no longer a node of the diagram is gone (kept, shown as 'element gone'). graph_hash is the approval key: the sha256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of the diagram file without its pure metadata (meta.commit, base_sha, branch, generated_at; path, line, end_line and note of every source evidence entry, and any path:LINE anchor inside a detail or text), keys sorted at every depth, every $-prefixed key dropped (shared/questions/vrlayout.ts approvalHash, scripts/vr_promote.py approval_hash). A verdict recorded on the old full-file hash (graphHash) still holds while the file is byte-identical to what it saw. A change of metadata only keeps the line current; a change of a step, lane, arrow, label or element makes it outdated. An element is a node of l0, l1 or l2.json, or (diagram arch:<stem>) of a new architecture diagram drafted in arch/<stem>.json of the same folder (Architecture impact: one review tab per new diagram of the dossier's `Diagrams new:` line; the stem must be a file in arch/, letters, digits, - and _ only). The approval of a new diagram is tied to the exact draft: every element ok on the draft's current hash.

element.description: The node id, the stable id of graph.schema.json.

verdict.description: remove = remove from scope. An element with no line is 'not yet looked at'.

blocking.description: Optional. Present only when the owner flagged a Question or Change as blocking; an informing line has no such field.

notes.description: Optional (unified feedback control). Feedback on an asset other than a diagram element, one note per anchor, written by the one Send review of the dossier page. Absent in files written before it; readers must ignore it. A blocking Question or Change note keeps the review from being Approved until cleared.

anchor.description: summary, doc:<section-slug>, adr:<id>, deferred:<D-id> or pane:<key>.

viewed.description: Optional. Anchors the owner marked as looked at: the anchors of notes, plus el:<diagram>:<element> for a diagram element. Information only; no verdict and no approval depends on it.
